subject: redPanda
pitch: A red panda balancing on a mossy branch. Rusty red fur on its back, a black belly and legs, a round white face with red tear marks running from the eyes, white-rimmed pointed ears, a little black nose, and a big fluffy tail with bold cream and ginger rings. It holds a bamboo shoot in one paw and looks delighted.

I'm leaning toward the branch running along X, with the panda seated sideways on it but its body turned slightly toward +Z, giving a charming three-quarter view rather than a straight head-on perch along Z, which would be harder to read.

Let the tail drape down the side and curl forward for a fluffy accent.
